add('01:10','01:15','Forest dialogue card','Vertical Japanese lettering on black, followed by an iris returning to the round animal.','もう威かさないから 勘辨しておくれよ……')

add('01:34','01:47','Falling fruit','The round animal moves against the tree. Fruit drops and piles around both animals. They sit near the trunk and lift fruit toward their mouths; more fruit falls.')
add('01:47','02:00','Wolf in the woods','A black wolf with pointed ears, long muzzle, visible teeth and bushy tail walks right on four legs. Tracking views carry it behind and between tree trunks.')
add('02:00','02:14','Fruit eaters and approaching wolf','The goat and round animal sit amid fallen fruit, eating and looking up. Cut back to the wolf continuing right; it reaches a rocky drop and lowers its head over the edge.')
add('02:14','02:23','Animals scatter','Back at the fruit tree, the goat runs away. The round animal remains briefly, then jumps right as the wolf rushes in. Cuts alternate the fleeing round animal with the wolf crouched near the trunk.')
add('02:23','02:37','Pursuit to the rocks','The wolf bounds right through the forest after the round animal. At a pile of stones, the round animal curls into a ball. The wolf arrives, rises on its hind legs and strikes/kicks the ball, sending it away.')
add('02:37','02:45','Rolling down the slope','The ball-shaped animal rolls along sloping ground and hits a tree; stars appear around it. It opens back into its rounded animal form at the base of the trunk.')
add('02:45','03:01','Wolf returns to the fruit tree','The wolf turns near the rocks, then runs back to the fruit-strewn tree, lowers its head to the ground and moves off left. The empty clearing fades to black.')
add('03:01','03:08','Meeting intertitle','Vertical Japanese narration on black.','其の夜、暴虐な狼に對する對抗策を協議する爲に村會が開かれました (card describing a village meeting about measures against the wolf).')
add('03:08','03:30','Animals seated in a room','A group sits in a circle under a hanging lamp, with sliding doors behind. Closer views pan across a dog, bearded/horned animals, and round animals, several resting heads on hands. The dark-eye-marked round animal raises its head, then stands.')
add('03:30','03:42','Standing speaker','A dialogue card interrupts the meeting. Back in the room, the round animal gestures, raises its arms and displays a small leaf-like object. A second card follows.','03:30–03:34: あ、さうだ 好い考へがある あっしにお委せ下さい; 03:39–03:41: どうです こんな風にやって……')
add('03:42','03:54','Transformation demonstration','The standing animal becomes a tall pale figure with an enlarged head, large eyes and long hanging tentacle-like strips below. add('04:10','04:30','Wolf above the mountain path','The wolf sits atop a high, cracked rock. Alternating views show the round animal walking below a rock wall and on a winding mountainside path. The wolf rises, jumps from its perch, and lands among large angular rocks.')
add('04:30','04:47','Encounter among rocks','The round animal continues along the cliff base. The wolf is revealed beside a rock, followed by a close view of its eyes and grinning mouth. An iris shows the round animal raising an arm.','04:45–04:47: やい狼！')
add('04:47','04:59','Changing shapes','At the rock wall the round animal stretches into a taller pale quadruped-like animal standing upright. Cuts show the wolf advancing. The tall shape collapses back into the round animal, which bends to the ground.')
add('04:59','05:13','Tall pale apparition and wolf','The round animal becomes the large-eyed, tentacle-skirted figure again. The wolf walks past it, turns, crouches and bares its teeth. The pale figure opens its mouth; the wolf leaps toward it.','05:11–05:12: しまった！')
add('05:13','05:32','Return to the waiting group','The round animal, back in its ordinary shape with neck cloth, walks away along the rocks and through the forest with its head lowered. A group including a rabbit, dog and round animals waits by a tree at the village edge. It approaches them.')
add('05:32','05:48','Group exchange','Iris views isolate the dog gesturing and then the round animal bowing, clutching its cloth and gesturing with one hand. The wider group faces it. The scene fades out.')

add('06:23','06:37','Telescope view of snowy mountains','A circular view pans across snow-covered peaks and slopes. A dotted trail crosses the snow. At the lower edge, the black wolf comes into view moving along the slope.')
add('06:37','06:44','Squirrel gives warning','The squirrel leaves the branch, lands by the trunk and opens its mouth with radiating marks. A Japanese warning card appears; the squirrel is then shown calling again.','狼が山を下りて來たぞーッ (“The wolf has come down the mountain"'!”).'"')

add('06:55','07:01','Squirrel on house ladder','The bushy-tailed squirrel climbs a vertical wooden ladder fixed against a house wall. It stops on a projecting rung/platform beneath a small roofed fixture, lifting an arm toward it.')
add('07:01','07:12','Animals hurry through the village','A large round animal and a smaller one move past thatched houses; the larger one repeatedly lifts its head and opens its mouth. Other animals run into view. A brief cut returns to the squirrel on the ladder.')
add('07:12','07:20','Interior fright and wolf entering village','A pale animal by a square opening in a raised floor jumps up. A cloud fills the room and the animal springs outside. Another animal runs beside a house. The wolf appears in a gap between buildings and runs across.')
add('07:20','07:30','Street transformations and barrel','A rabbit briefly appears in a spinning, compressed form. A larger pale animal looks around and moves down the street. Beside long boards leaning against a house, it bends by an upright wooden barrel and climbs into/onto it.')

add('08:54','09:06','Wolf at a cliff edge','The wolf approaches a bare tree on a high rock ledge, then looks outward and down. A reverse wide view shows small pale animals watching from a distant cliff top. Back at the tree, the wolf rises and leans toward the drop.')
add('09:06','09:15','Monkey climbs to the wolf','The view moves down the steep rock face to monkeys on lower ledges. One climbs up to the rim beside the tree. An iris shows it gripping the cliff edge and lifting a hand toward the wolf.')
